channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: The Mercedes GLC Electric Is Excellent to Drive and 111 Miles Short of Its Range Claim
item.dc:creator: carwow
item.description: carwow tests the Mercedes GLC electric: 490 hp, dual-motor four-wheel drive, 94 kWh battery, and a WLTP claim of 393 miles. Real-world result on a 40-minute test route: 282 miles. The car handles well and is fast. The 0 to 60 sprint came in at 4.06 seconds, quicker than the stated 4.3. The range gap and some budget-feeling interior materials are harder to excuse at £60,000 to £73,000.

item.title: Finland Turned Off Its Oil Heating This Winter. A Silo of Sand Took Over.
item.dc:creator: IE Explains
item.description: Polarite Energy's 100 MWh sand battery, the world's largest, heated a Finnish town of 5,000 through one of the harshest winters on record using 2,000 tonnes of soapstone at up to 600 degrees Celsius. Result: 100% oil reduction, 70% CO2 cut, 60% less wood chip combustion. System cost runs $10 to $50 per kWh against $100 to $200 for lithium-ion, with a 50-year projected lifespan.

item.title: Hyundai's Robotaxi Drove Itself Around Las Vegas for Six Weeks. Out of Spec Took a Ride.
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews rides Motional's Hyundai Ioniq 5 robotaxi in Las Vegas six weeks into commercial operation. The ride was smooth and confident for most of the route, then produced two phantom braking events and a blocked intersection. Safety monitors remain aboard. Removal is planned before end of 2026. A Zoox comparison ride taken immediately after performed worse.

item.title: Segway's Electric Dirt Bike Has 21 kW, Beast Mode, and a 62-Mile Software Lock on All of It
item.dc:creator: Electric Cycle Rider
item.description: Six years after Segway left the electric dirt bike segment, the Xaber 300 arrives at $5,299 with 21 kW, four power modes, Marzocchi suspension, GPS, hill hold, traction control, and reverse. The top two power modes are locked until 62 miles are on the odometer. The first ride ran in modes 1 and 2 only. Wheelie mode and digital clutch are both coming via firmware update.

item.title: London Black Cabs Have Memorized 25,000 Streets Since 1865. Waymo Is Mapping Them Now.
item.dc:creator: 60 Minutes
item.description: 60 Minutes reports on Waymo and UK startup Wave preparing to launch autonomous taxis in London, where black cab drivers must pass The Knowledge, a licensing exam running since 1865 requiring memorization of 25,000 streets. One candidate spent five years and 41 attempts before passing. London's licensed cab driver count has fallen from 25,000 to 16,000 over the past decade.

item.title: 500 Real Kilometers at Motorway Speed. The Mercedes CLA EQ Delivers More Than Its Battery Size Suggests.
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl drives the Mercedes CLA EQ from central Germany to Hamburg and back. The 85 kWh 4MATIC averaged 17 kWh per 100 km, projecting 500 km realistic range at 130 km/h. Fast charge session: 21 minutes, 175 kW average. Prices from under €50,000.

item.title: First Government Bid, First Customer Delivery: Solarpunk Steve Wins a County Emergency Management Solar Contract
item.dc:creator: Solarpunk Steve
item.description: Solarpunk Steve won a competitive government contract to build a mobile solar generator trailer for a county emergency management department 1,200 miles away. He had never bid on a government contract. He submitted a 23-page proposal and won. He has under one month to build and deliver.

item.title: Forged Wheels on the Rivian R1S Added Seven Miles of Range. The Other Changes Were the Point.
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs swaps stock off-road wheels on a 2026 Rivian R1S for forged Atomic Wheels AWX with Hankook iON HT tires, 14 to 15 lbs lighter per corner. Range in conserve mode went from 372 to 379 miles. Cabin noise, steering feel, and ride quality improved significantly.

item.title: Kia Built a Van That Drives Like an EV and Priced It Within Three Grand of a Golf
item.dc:creator: Cars Uncovered
item.description: Cars Uncovered reviews the Kia PV5 at £32,995. It converts between a family car, crew vehicle, and cargo van with a screwdriver. Holds 1,300 liters, charges at 150 kW, and runs quieter than two generations of Tesla Model 3. Long-range variant: 256 miles.

item.title: The CleverCharge Reads Your Car's OBD2 Port and Calls Itself the Smartest Home EV Charger. Mostly Right.
item.dc:creator: State Of Charge
item.description: State of Charge reviews the CleverCharge Home. An OBD2 CleverKey dongle pulls battery state of health, real-world range estimates, and driving patterns into the app. Scores 4.2 out of 5 stars at $399 for the 40-amp version. Gaps: no power sharing, no charge stop control, AI cost comparison inaccurate.

item.title: Nyck de Vries Ends Four-Year Formula E Drought with Monaco Victory
item.dc:creator: Formula E
item.description: Mahindra Racing's Nyck de Vries won Round 9 at Monaco, ending four years without a Formula E win. Mitch Evans takes the championship lead from second place. Pepe Martí earns his first podium after a late penalty reshuffles the results.

item.title: Six Panels, One Trailer: Building a Mobile Solar Rig for an All-Electric Lawn Business
item.dc:creator: Solarpunk Steve
item.description: Solarpunk Steve built a solar-powered lawn care trailer with six 200W panels, an EG4 inverter, and a 5kW server rack battery to charge an all-electric mowing fleet on-site, measuring 780W real-world output in full sun.

item.title: Scaringe Confirms More R2 Models Are Coming. The R2X Is the Logical First.
item.dc:creator: This Car Pod! Clips
item.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe confirmed additional R2 variants are in development. The This Car Pod team identifies a performance off-road R2X as the most logical next step, following the pattern Rivian established with the R3X.

item.title: VW ID. Polo GTI Arrives, Jaguar Gets Its Production Name, and UK Used EV Sales Jump Nearly a Third
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Kilowatt Half Hour Ep 106 covers the VW ID. Polo GTI with 226hp, Jaguar officially naming its electric GT the Type 01, and SMMT data showing UK used EV sales up nearly 33% in Q1 2026, reaching 1 in 23 used car transactions.

item.title: The Cheapest New EV in America Is Being Driven Coast to Coast on IONNA Charging Only
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews drives a 2027 Chevy Bolt EV from Virginia Beach to LA on IONNA stations only, stress-testing 150kW charging and LFP battery chemistry on a coast-to-coast route with no planned stops.

item.title: Volkswagen’s First Electric GTI: 226 hp, 24-Minute Charging, and a €40,000 Question
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl examines the pre-production ID Polo GTI: 226 hp on the front axle with an electronic differential lock, DCC adaptive suspension exclusive to the GTI trim, a 52 kWh NMC battery with 105 kW DC charging from 10 to 80 percent in 24 minutes, and a top speed of 175 km/h. Clark tartan seats, a physical GTI button on the steering wheel that triggers a dedicated drive mode and retro gauge display, and 440 litres of boot space. Pricing is not yet confirmed but expected around €40,000.

item.title: Munro Live Breaks Down the R2 at ACT Expo: The Cost-Reduction Story Is in the Details
item.dc:creator: Munro Live
item.description: Sandy Munro’s team walks through the Rivian R2 at ACT Expo 2026 with a Rivian fleet sales representative. The conversation covers the simplified single-piece frunk liner with fewer fasteners versus the R1, a clamshell hood, squared mirror arms, a recessed rear wiper tested extensively for drainage and ice, and the Halo haptic electromechanical scroll wheels that adjust detent resistance and throw contextually based on which vehicle setting is being changed. The R2 launches at $57,990 with 330 miles of range and 0 to 60 in 3.5 seconds.

item.title: The R2 Configurator Is Live: What the Launch Package Includes and How to Save $650
item.dc:creator: Travis Ketchum
item.description: Travis Ketchum walks through every option on the live R2 configurator. Paint runs from free for Escer Silver to $2,000 for Midnight, Catalina Cove, and Launch Green. The all-terrain 20-inch wheel upgrade is $1,000 and drops range from 330 to 307 miles. The compact spare adds $755. Buyers in 13 qualifying states, including California, Washington, New York, and Colorado, can receive $650 in charging accessories at no added cost by selecting them at checkout. Launch Green is exclusive to performance launch edition orders.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
